items.context: of B2B software buyers now start their research with AI chatbots. The buying journey now begins inside ChatGPT and Perplexity, before anyone reaches your site.
AI-referred visitors convert at roughly 11.4% versus roughly 5.3% for organic search. The few visitors AI sends arrive with higher intent.
AI referral traffic grew year over year. Still a small share of total traffic today, but the trajectory is the story.
